CB15 DRAFT, not in queue/jobs: needs the code-against-design freeze check (science-reviewer, part P) and the committed rules file; the coordinator regenerates the rules and these shas if any common / P code changes. P-17: a pair with >= 3 failed attempts in 3 separate runs spanning >= 15 min becomes 'unavailable (source)' (counted, never a unit) so the run can complete; re-run until complete. P-23: the queue worker re-starts a repeat run at once, so the run gap is enforced in code (a run that starts < 15 min after the previous run that left failed pairs exits 75 = retry_wait 30 min, not counted as a run or attempt); max_runs 8 = 3 failing runs + 1 labelling run + 4 spare runs for a budget-limited first pass, so the terminal rule is always reachable.
